title: Character animation manifest
description: Describes a character's sprite sheets. Each key under `animations` is an action the behavior code plays by that exact name; hover a key for when it fires.

$schema.description: Path to this JSON schema (enables editor autocomplete).

id.description: Folder-safe character id. Must match the assets/chars/<id>/ folder name.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

sprite.description: Default frame grid applied to every animation. Each animation may override any of these fields.

renderScale.description: On-screen size relative to the frame size. 0.5 = half the frame size.

defaultFacing.description: Direction the sheets are drawn facing. The renderer mirrors frames automatically for the opposite direction.

idleFootGap.description: Gap in rendered px between idle's own drawn feet and the position anchor (idle's natural empty margin below its feet). Other animations are calibrated via scale/offsetY to match this same gap so switching between them doesn't visually jump. Behaviors that need literal contact with an element edge (e.g. 'sit') add this value back in when computing where to walk, since the anchor point itself is the sprite box's edge, not the drawn feet. Measure it once from idle's sheet; 0 if idle's feet already sit flush with the cell edge.

animations.description: The character's sprite sheets, keyed by animation name. Only the names listed here are ever played by the behavior code — an entry under any other name would never be used, so unknown keys are rejected rather than silently ignored. Every name except `idle` is optional: a missing one falls back to `idle` at runtime.

idle.description: Resting loop. Plays whenever nothing else is happening, and is the automatic fallback for every other action whose sheet is absent — which is why this one is required.

walk.description: Travel cycle, played while walking toward a target along a mostly-horizontal path, and while the user drags the character.

hop.description: Alternative travel cycle, used instead of `walk` when the path to the target is steeper than CONFIG.steepWalkAngleDeg — a horizontal stride reads as sliding sideways at steep angles.

read.description: Plays on arrival at a heading or text block (H1, H2, H3, P, ARTICLE).

look.description: Plays on arrival at an image, code block or input (IMG, PRE, CODE, INPUT). Also the fallback for any target type with no mapping of its own.

sit.description: Plays on arrival at a button or link (BUTTON, A). This is the action that uses the character's `idleFootGap`, so the feet land flush on the element's top edge.

watch.description: Plays on arrival at a video that is NOT currently playing.

watch_film.description: Plays on arrival at a video that IS currently playing, including one inside an embedded iframe. Only reachable while the "Watch playing videos" setting is on.

write.description: Plays after the character walks over to a text field the user just focused. Only reachable while the "Take notes while typing" setting is on.

sleepy.description: Drowsy lead-in to `sleep` — a yawn/eye-rub that plays for CONFIG.drowsyMin..drowsyMax ms before the sleep loop starts. Falls back to `idle` for that beat if absent, which still reads as settling down.

sleep.description: The sleep loop itself, entered right after the `sleepy` beat. The whole sequence is randomly triggered, with a chance that depends on the activity level, and only while the "Sleep" setting is on.

happy.description: One of the two reactions picked at random when the user clicks the character.

surprised.description: The other reaction picked at random when the user clicks the character.

frameWidth.description: Width of a single frame in px.

frameHeight.description: Height of a single frame in px.

columns.description: Number of frame columns in the sheet.

rows.description: Number of frame rows in the sheet.

frames.description: Total frames actually used (may be fewer than columns x rows).

scale.description: Visual zoom applied on top of renderScale, anchored at the bottom-center. Use this when a sheet draws the character larger/smaller within its cell than other sheets, to avoid a jump/zoom effect when switching animations. 1 = no change.

offsetX.description: Horizontal nudge in px, applied after scaling. Use to fix left/right drift introduced by scale.

offsetY.description: Vertical nudge in px, applied after scaling. Use to realign the baseline (feet) between sheets.

animation.description: One animation. Inherits the top-level `sprite` grid; override any field when this sheet differs.

sheet.description: Sprite sheet file name, relative to the character folder.

columns.description: Frame columns in this sheet (overrides sprite.columns).

rows.description: Frame rows in this sheet (overrides sprite.rows).

frames.description: Frames used in this sheet (overrides sprite.frames).

fps.description: Playback speed in frames per second.

loop.description: Whether the animation repeats. false holds on the last frame.

scale.description: Visual zoom applied on top of renderScale, anchored at the bottom-center (overrides sprite.scale). Use this when this sheet draws the character larger/smaller within its cell than other sheets, to avoid a jump/zoom effect when switching animations. 1 = no change.

offsetX.description: Horizontal nudge in px, applied after scaling (overrides sprite.offsetX).

offsetY.description: Vertical nudge in px, applied after scaling (overrides sprite.offsetY). Use to realign the baseline (feet) between sheets.
